annotation.title_clean: Commission Staff Working Document Impact Assessment: Proposal for a Regulation establishing the Digital Europe programme for the period 2021-2027
annotation.title_en: Commission Staff Working Document Impact Assessment: Proposal for a Regulation establishing the Digital Europe programme for the period 2021-2027
annotation.summary_en: Commission impact assessment accompanying the proposal for the Digital Europe programme (2021-2027, EUR 9.194bn). It justifies EU-level investment in high-performance computing, AI, cybersecurity, advanced digital skills and digital deployment, and covers delivery mechanisms, state aid and monitoring. Robotics appears only in passing, as AI testing sites.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a EUR 9.194bn Digital Europe programme for 2021-2027 built on five pillars: HPC, AI, cybersecurity, advanced skills, and deployment/interoperability.
Argues EU-level action is needed because Member States cannot reach the scale of investment alone, citing the US and China.
AI pillar funds common data spaces, algorithm libraries and testing sites that include robotics.
Delivery relies on procurement, grants, financial instruments, the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking and Digital Innovation Hubs.
Monitoring uses the DESI index and programme-specific indicators, with a mid-term evaluation by 2024 and a final evaluation by 2028.
